subject: [hw] IK -> T02: confirm the exact phone order for INTEGRATION.md (preflight/jpeg/vcodec/daemon)
body:
IK -> T02: please confirm the exact phone order I will put in kern/INTEGRATION.md, taken from your tests/phone/README.md and guest-n2hw-tests.sh.

Proposed order (main session, one image):
1. Install the five guest files with the rootfs transaction (your INSTALL.md), no launchd job at boot.
2. Flash the exact boot image, boot, `python3 gpu/build/autotest/phone.py wait`, fetch the boot log. Pass: three nodes and the two startup lines, no register line.
3. `STAGE=preflight n2hw_phone_tests` -> PASS device nodes, PASS rwvc-info, PASS rwvc-client (plus rwjpeg-info). No register touched.
4. `STAGE=jpeg n2hw_phone_tests` -> selftest PASS 12/12, bench, enc; fetch hw640.jpg/src640.nv12; PC jpeg_check.py PASS.
5. `STAGE=vcodec n2hw_phone_tests` -> rwvc_probe all PASS, read done=6/6; then phone.py status after 60 s (the camera-hang wait). Only after opus-kern's 0311 VENC numbers are in the image.
6. `STAGE=daemon` only with ENABLE_DAEMON=1 once hw-ip/hw-p03 confirm the binaries; fetch out.h264; PC h264_check.py PASS.
7. Recovery: q10ik/q10hw1 boot image or the RAM ADB rescue; never stock Android over iOS.

Is the guest runner order `preflight; jpeg; vcodec; daemon` (the `all` case) the one you want, or should 20-vcodec-readonly come before 10-jpeg as the milestone files suggest? I will quote the runner order unless you say otherwise. Also: is `PHONE_EXEC`/`PHONE_GET` the only supported path from the main session on this build (no shell on the phone per opus-ios), or should INTEGRATION.md say the guest script is run through the one-shot launchd job?
